name: UniFFBench
description: Universal machine learning force fields (UMLFFs) promise to revolutionize materials science by enabling rapid atomistic simulations across the periodic table. However, their evaluation has been limited to computational benchmarks that may not reflect real-world performance. We introduce UniFFBench, a comprehensive evaluation framework featuring the MinX dataset -- a diverse collection of 1,500+ mineral systems spanning 85 elements, extreme thermodynamic conditions (0--5000 K, 0--1000 GPa), and structural complexity, including partial occupancy and disorder.
